item.title: GIS Co-Scientist: a human-AI collaborative framework for autonomous geospatial scientific inquiry
item.dc:title: GIS Co-Scientist: a human-AI collaborative framework for autonomous geospatial scientific inquiry
item.dc:creator: Temitope Akinboyewa Zhenlong Li Geoinformation and Big Data Research Lab, Department of Geography, The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA, USATemitope Akinboyewa is a PhD candidate in the Department of Geography, Pennsylvania State University and a member of the Geoinformation and Big Data Research Laboratory (GIBD). His research interests are in GIScience, Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI), Autonomous GIS and big data analytics with applications in public health, natural disaster and human mobility.Zhenlong Li is an Associate Professor at Pennsylvania State University, and Director of Geoinformation and Big Data Research Laboratory (GIBD). His primary research field is GIScience with a focus on geospatial big data analytics, spatial computing, Autonomous GIS, and Geospatial AI with applications to disaster management, human mobility, and public health.
